🇸🇦 Saudi wealth fund headquarters damaged in Riyadh missile attack Windows were blown out across several floors of Riyadh’s tallest skyscraper early Thursday. The 80-story tower houses Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund, the sovereign wealth fund chaired by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and central to his plans to diversify the economy beyond oil. Three sources told Reuters an incoming Houthi missile hit the tower. The Saudi-led coalition said falling debris caused damage in Riyadh and gave no location. The Houthis have yet to claim responsibility, but there were no immediate reports of casualties. It was the second attack to damage a major building in Riyadh’s financial district in less than two weeks. A November 8 attack damaged an office used by state oil giant Saudi Aramco. Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and oil infrastructure have intensified since fighting in Yemen resumed this summer. 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime

الامين العام لكتائب حزب الله المنصورة ابو حسين الحميداوي: أَتَوَجَّهُ بِالشُّكْرِ الْجَزِيلِ إِلَى جَمِيعِ الْإِخْوَةِ وَالْأَخَوَاتِ دَاخِلَ الْعِرَاقِ وَخَارِجَهُ، مِمَّنْ شَارَكُوا وَيُشَارِكُونَ فِي حَمْلَةِ الدِّفَاعِ عَنْ رِجَالِ الْمُقَاوَمَةِ الْإِسْلَامِيَّةِ الظَّافِرَةِ، فِي مُوَاجَهَةِ مَا تَتَعَرَّضُ لَهُ مِنْ هَجَمَاتٍ بَرْبَرِيَّةٍ تَشُنُّهَا قُوَى الِاسْتِكْبَارِ الْعَالَمِيِّ، فِي مُحَاوَلَةٍ لِلنَّيْلِ مِنْ صُمُودِهَا وَعِزَّتِهَا، وَكُلُّنَا ثِقَةٌ بِوَعْدِ اللَّهِ وَنَصْرِهِ.
